questions.question: How many minutes of physical activity should teens get each day?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 60 minutes
questions.explanation: That hour can be split up - gym class, walking to school, sports, and dancing all add up toward the 60 minutes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Move 60 minutes a day.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of regular exercise?
questions.correctAnswer: It strengthens the heart, muscles, and bones
distractors: It removes the need for food
questions.explanation: Regular exercise improves heart health, strength, and mood.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Exercise strengthens your whole body.

questions.question: What is a warm-up?
questions.correctAnswer: Light activity before exercise to prepare muscles
questions.explanation: Warming up raises heart rate and loosens muscles before harder activity.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Warm up before you work out.

questions.question: What is a cool-down?
questions.correctAnswer: Light activity after exercise to help the body recover
questions.explanation: Cooling down lowers heart rate slowly and stretches muscles.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Cool down after you work out.

questions.question: Why is stretching important?
questions.correctAnswer: It improves flexibility and lowers injury risk
questions.explanation: Gentle stretching lengthens tight muscles and improves range of motion, so joints move more freely during activity.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Stretch to stay flexible.

questions.question: What is the recommended amount of sleep for teens?
questions.correctAnswer: 8 to 10 hours per night
questions.explanation: Teens need 8 to 10 hours of sleep for growth, learning, and mood.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Teens need 8 to 10 hours.

questions.question: Why is sleep important for teens?
questions.correctAnswer: It helps the brain learn, remember, and grow
distractors: It makes you need less food
questions.explanation: Sleep supports memory, mood, and physical growth.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sleep helps your brain learn.

questions.question: What is a healthy bedtime habit?
questions.correctAnswer: Keeping screens off an hour before bed
questions.explanation: Screens can keep the brain awake, so turning them off helps sleep.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Screens off before bed.

questions.question: Which food group should fill about half your plate?
questions.correctAnswer: Fruits and vegetables
questions.explanation: MyPlate is the USDA guide: fruits and vegetables take half the plate, while grains and protein share the other half, with dairy on the side.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Half your plate: fruits and veggies.

questions.question: What is the main job of protein?
questions.correctAnswer: To build and repair body tissues
questions.explanation: Protein builds muscles, skin, and other tissues.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Protein builds and repairs.

questions.question: What is the main job of carbohydrates?
questions.correctAnswer: To give the body energy
questions.explanation: The body breaks carbohydrates down into glucose, the fuel your brain and muscles burn first during activity.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Carbs give energy.

questions.question: What is the main job of calcium?
questions.correctAnswer: To build strong bones and teeth
questions.explanation: Teens are still building bone mass, so calcium eaten now is deposited into bones and teeth while they are growing.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Calcium builds bones.

questions.question: What is the main job of iron?
questions.correctAnswer: To help carry oxygen in the blood
questions.explanation: Iron is part of hemoglobin, which carries oxygen.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Iron carries oxygen.

questions.question: What is a whole grain?
questions.correctAnswer: A grain that keeps all its parts, like whole wheat
distractors: A grain that is white only
questions.explanation: Whole grains keep the bran, germ, and endosperm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Whole grains keep all parts.

questions.question: Which drink is healthiest for hydration?
questions.correctAnswer: Water
questions.explanation: Water hydrates without sugar or caffeine.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Water is the best drink.

questions.question: How much water should teens drink each day?
questions.correctAnswer: About 8 cups, more when active or hot
questions.explanation: Thirst, body size, and sweat losses change the exact amount - pale yellow urine is a good sign you are drinking enough.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Drink about 8 cups a day.

questions.question: What is a balanced meal?
questions.correctAnswer: A meal with foods from several groups in the right amounts
distractors: A meal with only one food
questions.explanation: Balanced meals mix grains, protein, fruits, vegetables, and dairy.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Balance means many groups.

questions.question: What is the difference between a whole food and a processed food?
questions.correctAnswer: Whole foods are close to their natural state; processed foods are changed a lot
questions.explanation: Processed foods often add sugar, salt, and fat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Whole foods are less changed.

questions.question: What is a food label's serving size?
questions.correctAnswer: The amount the nutrition facts describe
distractors: The amount in the whole package
questions.explanation: Nutrition facts are for one serving, not the whole package.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Check the serving size first.

questions.question: Why should teens limit sugary drinks?
questions.correctAnswer: They add calories and sugar without nutrients and harm teeth
questions.explanation: Sugary drinks raise the risk of cavities and weight gain.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sugary drinks add empty calories.

questions.question: What is BMI?
questions.correctAnswer: A measure that compares weight to height
questions.explanation: BMI is a screening tool, not a full health test.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: BMI compares weight and height.

questions.question: What is the best way to build strength safely as a teen?
questions.correctAnswer: Bodyweight exercises and light weights with good form
questions.explanation: Safe strength training uses good form and gradual progress.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Good form beats heavy weights.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel pain during exercise?
questions.correctAnswer: Stop and tell an adult
questions.explanation: Pain can signal injury, so stop and get help.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Pain means stop and tell someone.

questions.question: What is the RICE method for a minor injury?
questions.correctAnswer: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation
questions.explanation: RICE helps minor sprains and strains heal.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: RICE is Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.

questions.question: What should you do for a small cut?
questions.correctAnswer: Clean it, apply pressure, and cover it with a bandage
questions.explanation: Cleaning and covering a cut prevents infection.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Clean, press, cover.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is choking and cannot speak?
questions.correctAnswer: Give abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver) and call for help
questions.explanation: Abdominal thrusts can dislodge food blocking the airway.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Thrusts can clear a blocked airway.

questions.question: What number do you call in a U.S. emergency?
questions.explanation: 911 connects you to police, fire, and medical help.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Call 911 in an emergency.

questions.question: What should you do for a nosebleed?
questions.correctAnswer: Lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose
distractors: Lean back and tilt your head
questions.explanation: Leaning forward keeps blood from going down the throat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Lean forward and pinch.

questions.question: What is the best way to prevent the spread of germs?
questions.correctAnswer: Wash hands often with soap and water
questions.explanation: Handwashing removes germs before they spread.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Wash your hands often.

questions.question: How long should you wash your hands?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 20 seconds
questions.explanation: Scrubbing for 20 seconds removes most germs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Wash for 20 seconds.

questions.question: What is the best way to prevent cavities?
questions.correctAnswer: Brush twice a day, floss, and limit sugary foods
questions.explanation: Brushing and flossing remove plaque that causes cavities.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Brush twice, floss daily.

questions.question: How often should you visit the dentist?
questions.correctAnswer: About every six months
questions.explanation: Regular checkups catch problems early.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: See the dentist twice a year.

questions.question: What is mental health?
questions.correctAnswer: How you think, feel, and handle stress and relationships
questions.explanation: Mental health is shaped by sleep, friendships, stress, and even physical health - the mind and body affect each other.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mental health is how you feel and cope.

questions.question: What is a healthy way to handle stress?
questions.correctAnswer: Talking to someone, exercising, or taking deep breaths
questions.explanation: Coping works because each strategy lowers stress differently: movement burns off tension, breathing slows the heart, and talking helps you solve the problem.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Talk, move, breathe.

questions.question: What is anxiety?
questions.correctAnswer: A feeling of worry or fear that can affect daily life
questions.explanation: Normal worry fades when the test or game is over; anxiety sticks around, shows up often, and can make a teen avoid school, friends, or sleep.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Anxiety is heavy worry.

questions.question: What is depression?
questions.correctAnswer: A long-lasting feeling of sadness and loss of interest
questions.explanation: Depression lasts weeks and affects mood, energy, and interest.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Depression lasts a long time.

questions.question: What should you do if a friend talks about hurting themselves?
questions.correctAnswer: Tell a trusted adult right away
distractors: Tell them to get over it
questions.explanation: A trusted adult can get help fast.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Tell an adult right away.

questions.question: What is bullying?
questions.correctAnswer: Repeated hurtful behavior meant to harm or control someone
questions.explanation: Bullying is repeated, intentional, and involves a power imbalance.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Bullying is repeated and hurtful.

questions.question: What should you do if you see bullying?
questions.correctAnswer: Tell a trusted adult and support the person being bullied
questions.explanation: Adults can stop bullying, and support helps the victim.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Tell an adult and support the victim.

questions.question: What is cyberbullying?
questions.correctAnswer: Bullying that happens online or through messages
questions.explanation: Cyberbullying uses phones, social media, or games to hurt someone.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Cyberbullying happens online.

questions.question: What is a healthy friendship?
questions.correctAnswer: A relationship with respect, trust, and support
distractors: A relationship where one person controls the other
questions.explanation: In a healthy friendship you can say no, disagree, and be yourself without being teased, controlled, or left out.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Healthy friends respect you.

questions.question: What is consent?
questions.correctAnswer: Clear agreement to do something, freely given
questions.explanation: Consent must be freely given and can be withdrawn.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Consent is freely given.

questions.question: What is peer pressure?
questions.correctAnswer: Pressure from friends to act a certain way
questions.explanation: Peer pressure can push you toward good or bad choices.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Peer pressure pushes you to fit in.

questions.question: What is a good way to resist negative peer pressure?
questions.correctAnswer: Say no clearly and suggest something else
questions.explanation: A clear no plus an alternative keeps you safe and respected.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Say no and offer another idea.

questions.question: What is the legal drinking age in the United States?
questions.explanation: The 1984 federal law pushed every state to set 21 - selling alcohol to anyone younger is illegal everywhere in the U.S.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Drinking age is 21.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to the teenage brain?
questions.correctAnswer: It can harm brain development, memory, and judgment
questions.explanation: The teen brain is still developing into the mid-20s, and alcohol interferes with the areas that control decisions, impulses, and forming memories.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Alcohol harms the teen brain.

questions.question: What is nicotine?
questions.correctAnswer: An addictive chemical in tobacco and vapes
questions.explanation: Nicotine is addictive and harms the brain and body.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Nicotine is addictive.

questions.question: What is vaping?
questions.correctAnswer: Breathing in aerosol from an electronic device
questions.explanation: Vaping heats liquid into aerosol that can contain nicotine and chemicals.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vaping is not harmless water vapor.

questions.question: What is the main risk of vaping for teens?
questions.correctAnswer: Nicotine addiction and lung damage
questions.explanation: Nicotine changes the teen brain so it craves more, and the aerosol's chemicals irritate and inflame the airways.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vaping risks addiction and lungs.

questions.question: What is a drug?
questions.correctAnswer: A substance that changes how the body or brain works
questions.explanation: Drugs include medicines, alcohol, nicotine, and illegal drugs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Drugs change how the body works.

questions.question: What should you do if someone offers you drugs?
questions.correctAnswer: Say no and leave the situation
distractors: Try it once to fit in
Take it and throw it away later
questions.explanation: Saying no and leaving keeps you safe.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Say no and leave.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe online?
questions.correctAnswer: Keep personal information private and tell an adult about problems
distractors: Meet strangers from the internet alone
questions.explanation: Once a photo, address, or password is shared online you lose control of it - strangers can copy, save, and spread it.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Keep personal info private.

questions.question: What should you do if a stranger online asks to meet you?
questions.correctAnswer: Tell a trusted adult and do not meet them
distractors: Meet them in a public place alone
questions.explanation: People online can lie about their age and identity, so a 'friend' from a game or app may not be who they claim to be.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Tell an adult, do not meet.

questions.question: What is a strong password?
questions.correctAnswer: A long mix of letters, numbers, and symbols that you do not share
questions.explanation: Length matters most: a passphrase like 'tiger-river-7-sky' is easier to remember and far harder to guess than a short word.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Strong passwords are long and private.

questions.question: What is screen time?
questions.correctAnswer: Time spent using phones, computers, TVs, and games
questions.explanation: Screen time counts entertainment and communication on devices - it does not include reading a printed book or playing outside.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Screen time is device time.

questions.question: Why should teens limit screen time before bed?
questions.correctAnswer: Screens can make it harder to fall asleep
questions.explanation: Blue light and stimulation can delay sleep.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Screens delay sleep.

questions.question: What is a healthy body image?
questions.correctAnswer: Feeling good about your body and treating it with care
questions.explanation: A healthy body image focuses on what your body can do - run, learn, heal - instead of comparing it to edited photos online.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Care for your body.

questions.question: What is an eating disorder?
questions.correctAnswer: A serious unhealthy pattern of eating that harms health
questions.explanation: Eating disorders are serious and need help from adults and doctors.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Eating disorders need help.

questions.question: What should you do if you are worried about your eating habits?
questions.correctAnswer: Talk to a trusted adult or doctor
questions.explanation: Adults and doctors can give safe help.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Talk to an adult.

questions.question: What is the best way to prevent sunburn?
questions.correctAnswer: Use sunscreen, wear a hat, and seek shade
distractors: Stay in the sun all day
questions.explanation: Sunscreen and shade protect skin from UV rays.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sunscreen and shade protect skin.

questions.question: What SPF sunscreen is recommended for daily use?
questions.correctAnswer: SPF 30 or higher
questions.explanation: SPF 30 blocks about 97% of UVB rays; apply a thick layer and reapply every 2 hours, and after swimming or sweating.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Use SPF 30 or higher.

questions.question: What should you do if you get a sunburn?
questions.correctAnswer: Cool the skin, moisturize, and avoid more sun
questions.explanation: Cooling and moisturizing help sunburn heal.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Cool and moisturize sunburn.

questions.question: Why is it important to wear a helmet when biking?
questions.correctAnswer: It protects your head from serious injury in a fall
questions.explanation: In a crash a helmet absorbs and spreads out the impact force, protecting the skull and brain from the hardest hit.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Helmets protect your head.

questions.question: Why should you wear a seatbelt?
questions.correctAnswer: It keeps you safe in a crash
distractors: It is only for the driver
questions.explanation: Seatbelts hold you in place and reduce injury in crashes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Seatbelts save lives.

questions.question: What is the best way to cross a street safely?
questions.correctAnswer: Look both ways, use a crosswalk, and wait for the signal
distractors: Cross while looking at your phone
questions.explanation: Crosswalks and looking both ways keep you visible and safe.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Look both ways at a crosswalk.

questions.question: What is the main cause of teen car crashes?
questions.correctAnswer: Distracted driving, especially texting
questions.explanation: Distraction, speed, and inexperience cause most teen crashes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Distraction causes most teen crashes.

questions.question: Why is it unsafe to text while driving?
questions.correctAnswer: It takes your eyes, hands, and mind off the road
distractors: It is only illegal for teens
questions.explanation: Reading one text takes your eyes off the road for about 5 seconds - at highway speed that is like driving the length of a football field blindfolded.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Texting takes your eyes off the road.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe at a pool?
questions.correctAnswer: Swim with a buddy and follow the lifeguard's rules
questions.explanation: Swimming with others and following rules prevents drowning.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Swim with a buddy.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is drowning?
questions.correctAnswer: Call for help and throw a flotation device; do not jump in unless trained
questions.explanation: Untrained rescuers can also drown, so call for help first.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Call for help first.

questions.question: What is a healthy way to express anger?
questions.correctAnswer: Take deep breaths, walk away, and talk calmly later
questions.explanation: Anger raises your heart rate and tightens your muscles; slow breathing and a short walk let the body calm down before you speak.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Breathe, walk away, talk calmly.

questions.question: What is empathy?
questions.correctAnswer: Understanding how someone else feels
questions.explanation: Empathy is a skill you can practice: listen, ask how the person feels, and imagine the situation from their side before you respond.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Empathy understands others.

questions.question: What is the best way to build self-confidence?
questions.correctAnswer: Set small goals, practice, and celebrate progress
questions.explanation: Confidence grows from evidence - each finished goal proves to your brain that you can handle the next, slightly bigger one.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Small goals build confidence.

questions.question: What is the difference between a need and a want?
questions.correctAnswer: A need is required for health and life; a want is nice to have
questions.explanation: Needs include food, water, shelter, and safety; wants are extras.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Needs are required, wants are extras.

questions.question: What is a healthy decision-making step?
questions.correctAnswer: Think about choices, risks, and consequences before acting
questions.explanation: A simple method: name your choices, list a plus and a minus for each, then pick the option you would still defend tomorrow.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Think before you act.

questions.question: What is the best way to prevent the flu?
questions.correctAnswer: Get a flu vaccine and wash hands often
questions.explanation: The flu shot trains your immune system before flu season, and soap breaks apart flu germs on your hands so they cannot reach your eyes, nose, or mouth.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vaccines and handwashing prevent flu.

questions.question: What should you do when you have a fever and feel sick?
questions.correctAnswer: Rest, drink fluids, and tell an adult
questions.explanation: Rest and fluids help recovery, and adults can decide about care.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Rest and drink fluids.

questions.question: What is the difference between a virus and a bacterium?
questions.correctAnswer: Viruses need a host cell to copy; bacteria are single cells that can live alone
questions.explanation: Because bacteria are alive, antibiotics can kill them; antibiotics do not work on viruses, which is why most colds just have to run their course.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Viruses need a host, bacteria do not.

questions.question: What is an allergy?
questions.correctAnswer: An immune system reaction to something harmless, like pollen
questions.explanation: Allergies happen when the immune system overreacts.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Allergies are immune overreactions.

questions.question: What should you do if someone has a severe allergic reaction?
questions.correctAnswer: Call 911 and use an EpiPen if available
questions.explanation: Severe allergies can close airways fast, so act quickly.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Call 911 and use the EpiPen.

questions.question: What is the best way to protect your hearing?
questions.correctAnswer: Keep volume low and wear ear protection around loud sounds
questions.explanation: Loud sounds can damage hearing permanently.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Keep volume low.

questions.question: What is the best way to protect your eyes?
questions.correctAnswer: Wear sunglasses and take screen breaks
questions.explanation: Sunglasses block UV rays and breaks reduce eye strain.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sunglasses and breaks protect eyes.

questions.question: How often should teens have a checkup with a doctor?
questions.correctAnswer: About once a year
questions.explanation: Yearly checkups track growth and catch problems early.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Yearly checkups track health.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of eating breakfast?
questions.correctAnswer: It gives energy and helps focus at school
questions.explanation: Breakfast fuels the brain after the night's fast.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Breakfast fuels focus.

questions.question: Which snack is healthiest?
questions.correctAnswer: An apple with peanut butter
questions.explanation: Fruit plus protein gives lasting energy.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Fruit plus protein is a good snack.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay hydrated during sports?
questions.correctAnswer: Drink water before, during, and after activity
questions.explanation: Do not wait until you feel thirsty - thirst is a late signal, so drink on a schedule before, during, and after you play.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Drink water throughout.

questions.question: What is dehydration?
questions.correctAnswer: Not having enough water in the body
questions.explanation: Dehydration causes thirst, headaches, and tiredness.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Dehydration is too little water.

questions.question: What are the signs of dehydration?
questions.correctAnswer: Thirst, dry mouth, dark urine, and tiredness
questions.explanation: Urine color is the quickest check: pale yellow means hydrated, while dark yellow or amber means you need fluids soon.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Thirst and dark urine mean dehydration.

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a disagreement with a friend?
questions.correctAnswer: Listen, share your feelings calmly, and find a compromise
questions.explanation: Use 'I feel' statements - saying 'I felt left out' starts a conversation, while blaming and yelling usually starts a bigger fight.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Listen, share, compromise.

questions.question: What is active listening?
questions.correctAnswer: Paying full attention and showing you understand
questions.explanation: Show it with your body and words: face the speaker, nod, and repeat back what you heard in your own words to check you got it right.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Active listening is full attention.

questions.question: What is the best way to apologize?
questions.correctAnswer: Say you are sorry, admit what you did, and make it right
distractors: Say sorry but keep doing it
questions.explanation: A real apology takes responsibility and fixes the harm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Apologize and make it right.

questions.question: What is the difference between good stress and bad stress?
questions.correctAnswer: Good stress motivates you briefly; bad stress lasts and harms health
questions.explanation: Short stress can help performance; long stress harms health.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Short stress motivates, long stress harms.

questions.question: What is a coping skill?
questions.correctAnswer: A healthy way to handle hard feelings
distractors: A way to avoid all feelings
questions.explanation: Coping skills include breathing, talking, and moving.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Coping skills handle hard feelings.

questions.question: What is the best time to exercise?
questions.correctAnswer: Any time you can do it regularly
questions.explanation: Morning, after school, or evening all work - what builds fitness is showing up several days a week, week after week.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The best time is when you will do it.

questions.question: What is the main risk of energy drinks for teens?
questions.correctAnswer: High caffeine can raise heart rate and harm sleep
questions.explanation: One energy drink can hold as much caffeine as two or three sodas, which can cause a racing heart, jitteriness, and trouble sleeping that night.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Energy drinks have too much caffeine.

questions.question: How much caffeine is safe for teens?
questions.correctAnswer: Teens should avoid or limit caffeine as much as possible
questions.explanation: Pediatric experts put the teen ceiling at about 100 mg of caffeine a day - roughly one small coffee - and say energy drinks should be avoided completely.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Teens should limit caffeine.

questions.question: What is the best way to fall asleep faster?
questions.correctAnswer: Keep a regular sleep schedule and a dark, cool room
questions.explanation: A regular routine trains the body to sleep.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Regular schedule helps sleep.

questions.question: What is the best way to protect your skin from the sun?
questions.correctAnswer: Use sunscreen SPF 30 or higher and wear protective clothing
distractors: Stay in direct sun all day
questions.explanation: Sunscreen and clothing block harmful UV rays.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sunscreen and clothes protect skin.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of eating vegetables?
questions.correctAnswer: They give vitamins, minerals, and fiber with few calories
questions.explanation: The fiber in vegetables feeds healthy gut bacteria and slows digestion, so you feel full longer and absorb nutrients steadily.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Veggies give vitamins and fiber.

questions.question: What is a healthy way to deal with sadness?
questions.correctAnswer: Talk to someone you trust and do things you enjoy
questions.explanation: Talking and positive activities help sadness pass.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Talk and do things you enjoy.

questions.question: Why is it important to warm up before sports?
questions.correctAnswer: It prepares muscles and lowers injury risk
questions.explanation: Warm-ups raise heart rate and loosen muscles.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Warm up to prevent injury.
